heading: Travel sanctions
lead: The Secretary of State may deny a visa to, and the Secretary of Homeland Security may deny entry into the United States of, any alien who is—

tree.text: a corporate officer of a designated person; or
a principal shareholder with a controlling interest in a designated person.
